title: Sorted Sets
subtitle: Leaderboards, rate limiting, and range queries

content.text: Sorted Sets store members with a floating-point score. Members are always returned in score order.

content.code:
# Leaderboard
ZADD scores 1500 "alice" 2000 "bob" 1800 "carol"

# Top 3
ZRANGE scores 0 2 WITHSCORES REV

# Rank of a player (0-based)
ZRANK scores "alice"

# Range by score
ZRANGEBYSCORE scores 1700 2000

content.text: Sorted Sets can implement sliding-window rate limits by storing timestamps as scores.

questions.question: What command returns members of a sorted set by rank?
questions.explanation: ZRANGE returns members by their rank (position) in a sorted set.

faq.q: Can sorted set scores be negative?
faq.a: Yes. Scores are double-precision floats and can be any value including negative numbers.
